board: BTF-LIGHTING SK6812 RGBW LED strip, 60 LEDs/m, DC5V, 1 m (60 pixels), white PCB IP30, 3-pin JST-SM input (+5V, DI, GND)
reason: The 60-LED addressable-led model (ledProtocol sk6812-rgbw, GRBW, bpp=4) with a neopixel-based driver passed the part check on ESP32 and Pico. +5V carries an external 4.5-5.5 V / 4.8 A supply (80 mA per LED at full RGBW). The build notes say 3.3 V data is below the datasheet's 3.4 V VIH, so a 74AHCT125 level shifter is recommended.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/7/1/5/e/8/S60SK6812.pdf (60/m SK6812 strip drawing: pads +5V, DI, GND; 3P JST-SM lead); https://www.ledyilighting.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/5050smd-60leds-10mm-SK6812-RGBW-specification.pdf; https://thepihut.com/products/flexible-rgbw-led-strip-neopixel-ws2812-sk6812-compatible-60-led-metre
